headline: Congress named the post office at 108 North Main Street in Bucoda, Washington, after former mayor Rob Gordon.
what_it_does: This law renames a U.S. Postal Service facility in Bucoda, Washington, as the Mayor Rob Gordon Post Office. It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, mail delivery, or how the building operates.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 4, 2025.
